subject: Split red-eye pairings + ground transfer ops for ZenithCo execs

From: Sandra Lane <sandra.lane@zenithco.com>
To: priyom.das@redwood.com
Cc: carlos.m@zenithco.com
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 11:12:00 -04:00
Subject: Exec travel — red-eye split pairings + pickup windows

Hi Priyom,

We're finalizing flights for the ZenithCo exec delegation arriving for the Oct 4 workshop. We've got limited direct seats on the redeye, so travel ops split the group across two late-night flights arriving within a two-hour window.

Quick asks so we can lock PNRs:
- Can Redwood confirm pairing preferences for the four execs (who needs to sit together / window vs aisle)?
- We need to schedule a single staggered ground pickup to shuttle both flights — ideal pickup window is 06:30–07:30 local. Can your ops team manage a 2-vehicle pickup with a private vehicle for the CEO?
- One exec (M. Alvarez) has a TKC dietary restriction (strict vegetarian + nut allergy).
- Also confirm lounge access / priority lane for the CEO and a carry-on upgrade if possible.

I'll attach the tentative PNR batch and arrival times. If you prefer, Monica (cc'd) can take over the detailed seat mapping.

Thanks,
Sandra Lane
Head of Events, ZenithCo
Attachment: zenithco_pnr_batch_A.pdf (pdf)
From: priyom.das@redwood.com <priyom.das@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec travel — red-eye split pairings + pickup windows

Sandra — thanks for the heads up and the PNRs. Looping in Monica (travel coordination) and Dev (on-site ops) to scope pickup and VIP handling.

Actionable items from our side:
1) Monica will propose seat pairings by EOD Thu (we'll follow the exec seating protocol: CEO + COO get adjacent seats when possible; others based on preference).
2) Dev will confirm ground pickup capacity and vendor rates for 2 vehicles + private SUV for the CEO.
3) We'll flag the dietary restriction in the carrier notes and request special meal codes.
4) Please send passport names exactly as on travel docs and any TSA/visa notes for international delegation if applicable.

We can absorb the shuttle cost but will need ZenithCo approval for the private SUV upgrade and lounge passes. Can you confirm budget sign-off?

Priyom Das
Director, Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
